name: Kuudere Nee-chan Kansatsu Nikki ~Himitsu no Onani, Tousatsu Shichaimashita~
original_name: クーデレ姉ちゃん観察日記 ～秘密のオナニー、盗撮しちゃいました～
source:
I have an older sister.
My older sister, Rikka, is usually quiet and aloof, just like the cool, downcast heroines you see in anime.

(If this was the 2D world, this could be considered a cute trait... sigh...)

One day, something like that happened...

(What happened to my room??)

I can't quite describe it, but something just felt off. 
Then, after a series of events, I started observing the room regularly.

(Is something on the screen?)

When I played it back, I saw a surprising sight...!

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1037246]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我有一个姐姐。
我的姐姐立花平时很安静，很冷漠，就像你在动漫中看到的冷静、沮丧的女主角一样。

（如果这是2D世界，这也算是一个可爱的特质了……唉……）有一天，发生了这样的一件事……

（我的房间怎么了？？）我无法完全描述它，但感觉有些不对劲。
然后，在发生了一系列事件之后，我开始定期观察这个房间。

（屏幕上有东西吗？）当我回放时，我看到了令人惊讶的景象……！

[来自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1037246]Getchu[/url]]
